title: Setting Up the Equation
text: Start with v² = u² + 2as. Substitute v = 0, u = 25, and a = -9.8 to get: 0 = (25)² + 2(-9.8)(s)

title: Solving for s
text: Simplify: 0 = 625 - 19.6s. Rearrange to get: 19.6s = 625, so s = 625/19.6

title: Final Calculation
text: s = 625 ÷ 19.6 = 31.89 m. The positive answer confirms the ball rises upward as expected.
